dedupe_keys.name: state climate policy dashboard climate xchange including building energy codes

description: The State Climate Policy Dashboard, run by the non-profit Climate XChange, is a free interactive tool with state-by-state information on over 60 climate policies across seven policy areas, showing whether each policy is enacted, in progress or partially enacted, for policymakers, advocates and researchers. Its Buildings and Efficiency area includes a residential energy codes page that explains energy codes as the part of building codes setting minimum efficiency for new construction and renovation of walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, windows and doors, how states adopt codes through legislation, regulation or home rule, and each state's status; other building pages cover topics such as commercial codes and building performance standards. The pages carry print and download options and showed update dates in 2026 when read (03.05.2026 on the codes page). Coverage: US states. Access: free website. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: an advocacy organisation's compilation; state statuses should be checked against the enacted texts. Simulation uses: policy scenario inputs, such as code editions and performance standards, for state building stock and emissions models. Related records: the DOE state energy code adoption status and the ACEEE State and Local Policy Database.
